reason: The native semantic rectangle is logical and omits painted stroke support, as the existing P7-8 linear-control capture proves. It is not an oracle for Anima's specified clip/mask/trim/fixed-stroke/feather painted boxes. Dash uses conservative undashed bounds and text uses logical line boxes by D32. Independent semantic conformance and Chromium/Firefox overlays verify the shared calculator; no native-equivalence or pixel-budget claim is made.
